description: Defines the I18NLanguage entity class for ORM mapping, representing language information in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: I18NLanguage
classes.description: Entity class representing a language in the internationalization system, with properties like id, name, code, enabled status, added status, and modification timestamp.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the language.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the language.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the language.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the language.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code associated with the language.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code associated with the language.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the language is enabled.

methods.name: isAdded
methods.description: Checks if the language has been added.

methods.name: setAdded
methods.description: Marks the language as added or not.

methods.name: getModifiedAt
methods.description: Gets the timestamp of the last modification.

methods.name: setModifiedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the last modification.
